name: badge
title: Badge
description: A short, non-interactive label for status or a count, in six tones and four appearances, including a coloured dot before plain text.
usage: Use Badge for a word or a number that describes something next to it: a connection's state (appearance="dot"), a grant's mode (read-only, plaintext), a count. variant picks the tone (neutral, accent, danger, warning, success, info), appearance the weight: subtle in lists, solid for what must stand out, outline on busy surfaces, dot for live state. Keep it to one or two words; the text must say the status, never the colour alone. For a removable or clickable label use Tag; for a column's data type use TypeBadge; for a message use Alert.

props.name: appearance
props.description: subtle tinted, solid filled, outline bordered, dot a coloured dot before plain text; tint is Fluent's tint (the tone's fill and stroke, strong text), as Mightyconsole's statuses use.

props.name: size
props.description: sm (text.caption) in tables and trees, md (text.label) beside headings.

props.name: children
props.description: The label; truncates with an ellipsis when it does not fit.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The pill; data-slot="badge", data-variant, data-appearance, data-size.

slots.name: dot
slots.description: The coloured dot of the dot appearance, aria-hidden; data-slot="badge-dot".

accessibility: A <span> of text, read in place; not focusable and not interactive.
The status is in the words ("connected", "plaintext"); colour and the dot only repeat it, so nothing is conveyed by colour alone. The dot is aria-hidden.
Solid and subtle text colours are the status solid-fg and fg roles, which the token build checks for contrast on their backgrounds.
For a count, add context for screen readers when the number alone is ambiguous ("3 notices", or visually hidden text).
